verdict.rationale: Sketch documents a built-in local MCP server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch. Its AI page says an AI client can recreate text styles, colors, components and whole pages inside Sketch, and can rename, align and sort layers or replace text. A write-capable JavaScript plugin API and sketchtool add further programmatic surfaces, and community comments note the open JSON file format. Missing for 10: no documented list of MCP write tools, no independent hands-on confirmation that agent edits work, and the MCP server is local-only and tied to the Mac app, with no cloud or REST write API (OpenAPI probes returned 404).
